# Amgel Jodi

> GSB Konkani matrimony platform connecting families across India and the diaspora.

Amgel Jodi is a fully free matrimony service for the GSB (Gaud Saraswat Brahmin) Konkani community. All profiles are manually verified. Core features — profile creation, browsing matches, and connecting with families — are completely free with no paid tiers.

## Docs

- [About](https://amgeljodi.com/about): Mission and team behind Amgel Jodi
- [How It Works](https://amgeljodi.com/how-it-works): Step-by-step guide to finding a match
- [Privacy Policy](https://amgeljodi.com/privacy): How user data is handled
- [Terms of Service](https://amgeljodi.com/terms): Platform rules and guidelines
- [Child Safety](https://amgeljodi.com/child-safety): Child safety standards and reporting
- [Contact](https://amgeljodi.com/contact): Get in touch with the Amgel Jodi team
